author: reek
body: The names below are chosen from exactly that band. The sixteen accented Latin letters CCE carries in Tier 0 are e-acute, e-grave, e-circumflex, e-diaeresis, a-acute, a-grave, a-circumflex, a-diaeresis, o-acute, o-circumflex, o-diaeresis, u-acute, u-diaeresis, n-tilde, c-cedilla and i-acute; the fifteen Cyrillic are a o e i n t s r v l k m d p u. A letter outside that set is a Tier 1 character and takes the other path, so it would prove nothing about this band.

author: reek
body: This file will not compile against a seed built before 2026-07-27: the identifiers are error tokens there, which is what makes it evidence rather than decoration.

author: reek
body: Case conversion is deliberately not exercised here. The uppercase of these letters is a Tier 1 code point and to-upper answers a Char, so the identity is the honest answer and it is asserted by build/oracle-cce.ps1 rather than by a name.
